queries.query: grep -ril traitgym data/ and a scripted inventory of every record citing lit-genomics-20261011-traitgym-source-hf-metrics
queries.outcome: The store holds 251 TraitGym records from the 2026-10-11 pass, all resting on the Hugging Face metrics source and none on a paper: 1 benchmark, 4 protocols, 2 datasets, 81 configurations, 5 methods, 1 model, 156 evaluations, 156 results and 11 claims. Separately, GFMBench-API and the AlphaGenome Atlas contribute TraitGym protocols and subsets of their own from their own sources.
Two versions, v1 posted 2025-02-12 and v2 posted 2025-03-04, both with published field 'NA'. No journal version linked.

queries.query: Crossref works query.bibliographic=Benchmarking DNA Sequence Models for Causal Regulatory Variant Prediction; works/10.1101/2025.02.11.637758
queries.outcome: Only the posted-content record for the preprint, with an empty relation object: Crossref records no journal article for it.

Retrieved twice, 37 pages, main text and Supplementary Material in one file. The two downloads differ in their bytes (80426c49... and 5f424797...) because bioRxiv stamps each download; the pdftotext -layout text layer was byte-identical (23ae4d67...).
The page lists no separate supplementary file. The Supplementary Material is pages 19 to 37 of the same PDF, which is where Tables S1 to S11 are.

decision: Pinned the bioRxiv v2 preprint, which is still the version of record, and extracted every cell of the four printed result tables the metrics table does not cover: Table S11 (104 cells), Table 5 (18), Table 4 (6) and Table S4 (4). Table S8's 100 cells are the same measurements as 100 results already in the store, so they were reconciled cell by cell rather than re-extracted; all 100 agree at three decimal places. The benchmark's definition, splits, inputs, metric, uncertainty and leakage controls were written as 25 claims so that they rest on the paper rather than on a metrics table, and GPN-Promoter, the model the paper introduces, was registered.
gaps: Figures 5 to 10 and Figures S1 to S11 print no values, and bioRxiv publishes no source data file for the preprint, so the paper's headline comparisons (Figure 5 zero-shot and linear probing on both datasets, Figure 6 expanded datasets, Figure 7 full ensembles, Figure 8 lightweight ensembles, Figure 9 stratified results, Figure 10 Borzoi assays) could not be extracted. The stored Hugging Face metrics cover Figure 5 but not Figures 6 to 10.

The expanded datasets with millions of controls (Figure 6) have no printed values anywhere, in the paper or in the stored metric files, so the paper's own strongest claim for GPN-MSA is not in the store as a result.
Table S11 does not say, per cell, whether the printed value is the zero-shot or the linear probing score, and for Mendelian traits does not say which lightweight ensemble its Ensemble column is.
Table 5 reports the highest AUPRC among the Borzoi tracks of a tissue without naming the track, and does not say whether the value is a single track's AUPRC or an aggregate over the tissue's tracks.
Whether the per-trait AUPRCs of Table S11, the feature AUPRCs of Table 4 and the tissue AUPRCs of Table 5 use the chromosome-weighted average or a global AUPRC is not stated.

Table S1, S2, S3, S5, S6, S7 and S10 and Tables 1, 2 and 3 are descriptive, not results, and were taken into claims rather than result records. Table S7's ClinVar consequence counts were not transcribed in full; the claims cite the table instead.
coverage_claim: Bounded source-resolution and extraction pass for one paper, the TraitGym benchmark preprint, cutoff 2026-11-16. Not a systematic search of regulatory variant benchmarks, and not a re-extraction of the stored Hugging Face metrics.
